newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. weekly jobless claims data, dealers said on Thursday.
Weekly jobless claims for the week ended February 1, are forecast to be around 347,000 compared with 351,000 reported in the previous week.
"The market was quiet and featureless today due mainly to a shortage of players because of the Lunar New Year and Hari Raya Puasa holidays," a local dealer said.

"Some people are waiting for the weekly jobless claims figures but I don't think there will be much impact as most people have squared their positions ahead of the long Lunar New Year/Hari Raya Puasa weekend," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday, weekend and week-fixed were unchanged from Wednesday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, six-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
